notes: Mangara, the Diplomat, printed: 'Whenever an opponent attacks with creatures, if two or more of those creatures are attacking you and/or planeswalkers you control, draw a card.' Three players, Mangara under seat 2. Seat 1 attacks with two creatures and they attack seat 0 (the engine's defending player for seat 1), not seat 2: nobody attacks 'you', so seat 2 draws nothing (hand 0; seat 2 has not had a turn). Seat 0 takes 4.
